incident_details.description: High-risk automated detection of anomalous network traffic, file transfers, and configuration changes on 192.168.10.210, indicating potential unauthorized access or system compromise requiring immediate investigation.

risk_rating.rationale: High risk score, automated detection, and specific IOC findings across availability, confidentiality, and integrity indicate a significant and active threat with high probability of severe consequences.

triage.ioc_summary:

[CONFIDENTIALITY] Changes in network traffic telemetry (known bad IPs/domains), Anomalous file transfers — High risk score and automated detection indicate potential data exposure or exfiltration.
[INTEGRITY] Unexpected OS/ROMMON release versions installed, Configuration changes — High risk score and automated detection suggest potential system alteration or unauthorized changes.
